checkpoints.title: Sum a list safely
checkpoints.summary: Fix a loop that crashes on empty lists.
checkpoints.description:
The code below should compute the sum of a list of numbers but crashes on empty lists. Fix it so that it returns 0 for an empty list.

Use a `for` loop; do not call `sum()` directly.
checkpoints.starterCode:
# Python
nums = [1, 2, 3]
result = 0
for i in range(len(nums) + 1):
    result += nums[i]
print(result)
